questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. At its height, around 1,200 years ago, the city of Calakmul had a population of about 50,000 people, but the kingdom as a whole numbered more than 1.5 million.

B. Deep in the jungle of southern Mexico lie the ruins of a city that thrived for centuries before it was abandoned more than 1,000 years ago.

C. Archaeologists have uncovered 6,750 structures here-the largest is this pyramid temple, called, simply, 'Structure 2.'

D. Calakmul was once one of the two duelling superpowers-along with Tikal-of the Classical Mayan civilisation.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BDAC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• Sentence B will be the first sentence because it is an independent general statement. It is talking about a city located in the jungle of southern Mexico that was abandoned more than 1000 years ago.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it further explains Sentence B. It tells us that the abandoned city was named **Calakmul**.
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence because it tells about the details of Calakmul city, its population, etc.
 
• At last, sentence C will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• B: Deep in the jungle of southern Mexico lie the ruins of a city that thrived for centuries before it was abandoned more than 1,000 years ago.
 
• D: Calakmul was once one of the two duelling superpowers-along with Tikal-of the Classical Mayan civilisation.
 
• A: At its height, around 1,200 years ago, the city of Calakmul had a population of about 50,000 people, but the kingdom as a whole numbered more than 1.5 million.
 
• C: Archaeologists have uncovered 6,750 structures here-the largest is this pyramid temple, called, simply, 'Structure 2.'

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Deep in the jungle of southern Mexico lie the ruins of a city that thrived for centuries before it was abandoned more than 1,000 years ago. Calakmul was once one of the two duelling superpowers-along with Tikal-of the Classical Mayan civilisation. At its height, around 1,200 years ago, the city of Calakmul had a population of about 50,000 people, but the kingdom as a whole numbered more than 1.5 million. Archaeologists have uncovered 6,750 structures here-the largest is this pyramid temple, called, simply, 'Structure 2.'*

• **Aristocracy **is a form of government in which power and leadership are held by a small, privileged ruling class consisting of noble or wealthy individuals. • **Monarchy **is a form of government in which supreme authority is held by a single individual, usually a king, queen, or emperor, who inherits the position and holds it for life. __
 
• The given sentence is** grammatically incorrect.**
 
• Here,** 'has gathered around the area' **should be used instead of** 'have gathered around the area'.**
 
• If the **collective noun** refers to the group as a unit, then it takes **a singular verb.** If it refers to the individuals in the group or the parts that make up the group, then the verb should be **plural**.
 
• In the given sentence** 'the crowd' **is referring to the whole crowd.
 
 
• *Example: She saw **a flock of sheep.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The crowd **has gathered around the area** to watch the actors.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Nelson said, “I was playing cricket.”

options.text: Nelson said that he was playing cricket.
Nelson said that he had been playing cricket.
Nelson said I was playing cricket.
Nelson said that I was playing cricket.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Nelson said that he had been playing cricket.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The first person pronoun '**I**' will be changed into '**he**' as per the subject of** the reporting verb.**
 
• **'was playing' **will be changed into **'had been playing'** because **'the past continuous tense**' is changed into **'past perfect continuous tense'.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Nelson said that he had been playing cricket.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Direct Speech** में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Indirect Speech** में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• **Conjunction** '**that**' जोड़ा जाएगा और **comma** और **inverted commas** हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• **Reporting verb** के विषय के अनुसार प्रथम व्यक्ति सर्वनाम '**I**' को '**he**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• **'was playing'** को **'had been playing'** में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि '**past continuous **tense' को '**past perfect continouous tense**' में बदल दिया गया है।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2** है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The fielder'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'a brilliant catch'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'took' will be changed into 'was taken'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *A brilliant catch was taken by the fielder at the slip position.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

 
• ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• उदाहरण:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का subject ''The fielder'' है।​
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का object ''a brilliant catch'' है।
 
• Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा।
 
• 'took' को 'was taken' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अंत में, preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. “I have already spent it,” the thief replied.

B. “What! I will take you to the police right now,” Arun thundered.

C. “Give me back my money,” Arun said to the thief.

D. “Sir, please have some mercy on me,” the thief pleaded.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'CABD'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• Sentence C will be the first sentence because it is the starting of an incident. It is talking about Arun threatening the thief so that he gives his money back.
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence because it further explains what that thief did with the money.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence because it tells what Arun reciprocated after he listened to the thief spending his money.
 
• Lastly, Sentence D will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• C: “Give me back my money,” Arun said to the thief.
 
• A: “I have already spent it,” the thief replied.
 
• B: “What! I will take you to the police right now,” Arun thundered.
 
• D: “Sir, please have some mercy on me,” the thief pleaded.

 
 
 

Correct Sequence:__ *“Give me back my money,” Arun said to the thief. “I have already spent it,” the thief replied. “What! I will take you to the police right now,” Arun thundered. “Sir, please have some mercy on me,” the thief pleaded.*
